description:
Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data.
The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity.
Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control.
For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production.
Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide.
Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments.
Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies.
Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures.
We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD.


ABOUT THE TEAM

Immuta’s Request app Team builds the experiences and services that help enterprise customers discover, request, and provision access to data across complex data ecosystems. We combine intuitive user experiences with secure, scalable engineering to make data access more efficient, transparent, and trustworthy.

We work across frontend and backend technologies and partner closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver reliable workflows that help organizations unlock the value of their data responsibly.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer II on the Request App Team, you’ll independently deliver well-scoped, moderately complex features and project work that improves the ability to curate complex approval workflows that enable data consumers to discover and request access to the data they need. You’ll contribute to technical design discussions, work within established engineering direction, and collaborate across disciplines to build solutions that are intuitive, secure, and maintainable.

This is an individual-contributor role for an engineer who can execute reliably, seek clarification when ambiguity affects the work, incorporate feedback, and grow their technical judgment through increasingly complex assignments.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
 

 Design and implement backend services and APIs using TypeScript/NestJS and related technologies.

 Build frontend features in Angular and integrate them with shared design-system components.

 Own defined features, components, services, or moderately complex project workstreams from technical design through deployment and follow-up improvements.

 Develop workflow-driven functionality that helps users discover data, request access, and move through approval processes.

 Improve performance and scalability by optimizing application code, database queries, and service interactions.

 Write automated tests, participate in code reviews, and contribute to reliable, maintainable software.

 Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and engineers to clarify requirements and translate customer needs into effective technical solutions.

 Contribute to technical discussions, documentation, CI/CD improvements, and developer-experience initiatives.




REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
 

 Professional Experience:  Typically 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience delivering production software; demonstrated capability is more important than tenure alone.

 Frontend Development:  Proficiency with TypeScript/JavaScript and experience with Angular, React, or a comparable modern frontend framework.

 Backend Engineering:  Experience building APIs and services with NestJS, Node.js, or a comparable backend framework.

 Data & Systems:  Experience with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL, and a working understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and performance optimization.

 Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with containerization tools such as Docker or Kubernetes and modern CI/CD practices.

 Software Quality:  Experience writing automated tests, participating in code reviews, and applying sound software design and maintainability practices.

 Collaboration: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to share progress, ask effective questions, incorporate feedback, and work with Product, Design, and Engineering partners.

 Ownership & Growth:  Reliable follow-through on assigned work, appropriate escalation of blockers, curiosity, and a willingness to develop stronger technical judgment over time




Benefits
 
At Immuta, our goal is to help bridge the gap between personal and professional growth, so that our team members can be well and thrive personally and professionally. After all, great professional success stories rarely happen without great personal success stories! Our generous benefits package given to all full time employees includes:
 
- 100% employer paid Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision) premiums for you and your dependents (including Domestic Partners)
- Stock Options
- Paid parental leave (Both Maternity and Paternity)
- Unlimited Paid time off (U.S. based positions)
- Learning and Development Resources
 
Immuta provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, age, disability (including disability due to pregnancy) or genetics, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Immuta complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.
 
NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY RECRUITERS: Immuta does not accept candidates from third party recruiters. All candidates submitted through are considered to be submissions by the candidate and no submission will obligate Immuta to pay any third party for the referral or hiring of a candidate.
